name: DiCo-NLI (SemEval-2027 Task 2)
download: git clone https://github.com/ilopezgazpio/SemEval-2027-Task-2-DiCo-NLI.git datasets/dico-nli && git -C datasets/dico-nli checkout 588968e610197ddc4c440314701cbc587afc4c1b

splits.train: final_data/train, used for training and, through a grouped held-out slice, for model selection
splits.dev: final_data/dev, the course test set; the official test set is released on 2027-01-10 and is never used for selection

checksums: blob_sha1 is git's object id for the file at the recorded commit (git -C datasets/dico-nli ls-tree -r <commit> -- <path>) and is the same on every platform; md5_lf is the md5 of the file bytes after CRLF is normalised to LF, so a Windows checkout with autocrlf matches a macOS or Linux one.
notes: Every __flipped instance is the reversal of an __original one and NEGATIVE_OTHER instances have no flipped twin, so instance_id leaks the label; no model input may include it.
Track 1 train and dev share no pair_id; 7 unordered text pairs and 155 of 712 dev phrases also occur in train.
